# ProjectileAimbot

**Category:** Combat  
**Aliases:** ProjectileAimbot

## What it does

Automatically aims your held projectile weapon at the best nearby target. It calculates the correct launch angle for whatever projectile you are holding (bow, crossbow, trident, snowball, egg, etc.) and rotates toward the target so your shot connects.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/combat/projectileaimbot). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
